chapter: Honors, Gibson and Dorsey late years
title: Sardi's meals and Leeman's last record date with Tommy Dorsey
summary: Leeman and Shavers order from Sardi's instead of cooking, and after a Paramount show they cut a four-side session at Victor Studios, his last association with Dorsey.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: I must remark that back at the theatre, the Paramount Theatre, Charlie Shavers and I confined our culinary efforts to having a standard order with Sardi's, which was next door, and we had a waiter service, and about the biggest thing we cooked was music.

One minute after the last show, we had cabs waiting, and we did -- at the Paramount, a show at the Paramount, we had cabs waiting and we rushed down to Victor Studios on 24th Street and did a four sided record date with Tom Dorsey, and that, I believe was my last association with Tom, and of course, the last recordings with the exception
of the previous -- I mentioned before this doing an album with Paul Whiteman which featured his old players, Tom and Jim Dorsey, and that is the end of my association with Tom.
